section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining associations between body appreciation and need for uniqueness. The study found that individuals with higher body appreciation showed stronger need for uniqueness both generally and in appearance domains, even after controlling for sex, BMI, and race/ethnicity. Notably, body appreciation was not significantly associated with interest in cosmetic enhancements, and African American/Black participants demonstrated significantly higher need for uniqueness compared to other racial/ethnic groups.
